verdict.rationale: OpenClaw runs as a self-hosted Gateway process with no UI required. It can run in a throwaway Docker environment, and external services can drive it programmatically through HTTP hooks that submit agent turns, an OpenAI-compatible /v1/chat/completions endpoint, and a direct tool-invoke HTTP API. A built-in scheduler adds unattended automation, and one community user reports running scheduled multi-agent setups. Missing for 10: explicit CI-pipeline documentation (e.g. a non-interactive one-shot run mode, a CI recipe or GitHub Action) and hands-on corroboration of headless/CI runs.
